units.source_text: 他闭上眼睛，几条像喘息般流动的长线飘浮了过来。

en.t: He closed his eyes, and several long lines, flowing as if breathing, drifted toward him.

units.source_text: 它在沙丘上活动，哦，是风纹呀。

en.t: They moved over the dunes; ah, they were wind ripples.

units.source_text: 半天，他一直盯着看，眼底深处留下了烙印吧。

en.t: He had stared at them for a long time, and they must have left a brand deep in his eyes.

units.source_text: 那沙的流动消亡，吞噬了多少昔日繁荣的都市，甚至大帝国。

en.t: That flow and disappearance of sand had swallowed so many once-prosperous cities, even great empires.

units.source_text: 罗马帝国的，是叫萨布拉塔的吧……

en.t: The one from the Roman Empire was called Sabratha, wasn't it...

units.source_text: 后来奥马尔·哈雅姆歌唱过的，叫什么镇来着……

en.t: And the town that Omar Khayyam later sang of, what was it called...

units.source_text: 那里有裁缝铺、肉铺，还有杂货店，

en.t: There were tailor shops, butcher shops, and grocery stores there,

units.source_text: 还有许多决不会移动的道路，像网眼一样交织，

en.t: and many roads that would never move, interwoven like the mesh of a net,

units.source_text: 哪怕想改动一条道路，也非得经过镇公所好几年的辩论……

en.t: even changing a single road would have required years of debate at the town office...

units.source_text: 没有人会怀疑它的“不移动”，那个古镇……

en.t: No one would have doubted its immobility, that ancient town...

units.source_text: 但最终它无法战胜直径1/8mm“流动的沙”的法则。

en.t: But in the end, it could not defeat the law of flowing sand, one eighth of a millimeter in diameter.
